full_name: Mya Frazier | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2025–2026 Journalism & Nonfiction Jeffrey S. and Margaret Mais Padnos Fellow Independent Writer
bio: Mya Frazier is an independent journalist based in Ohio who writes about financial identity and the power of the US financial system in the lives of low-income Americans. At Radcliffe, Frazier will write a nonfiction book about three American families living under the stigma of bad credit and debt.
